body: The seed bag is kept beside a water bottle, both stained with the same pale residue; the notebook page where the plot directions should be has been removed.
title: Plot with no note

body:
Orchard diary: at the apple mark, windfalls carried a waxy film after the trial pass. The buyer rejected the whole load as unfit.

The trees on the treated side had dropped fruit three weeks early. The untreated side held.

I set a few windfalls aside to show the neighbor when she returned. They had split and gone sticky by evening.
title: Apple mark beside treated windfalls

body:
Repair receipt: the hammer mark identifies the pump sealed after drawing cloudy field water. Its gasket was new, yet the metal inside had turned green.

The pump fed the spray tanks for the trial plots. The water in the tank had a sweet, solvent smell.

I wrote the date of the repair here before the pump went back into the line.
title: Hammer mark for a sealed pump

body:
Cash slip at the fuel symbol: twelve gallons for the trial sprayer, though its tank holds eight. The clerk wrote the excess under a second farm number.

The extra four gallons went somewhere else on the trial grounds. The clerk would not say where.

I kept the stained copy because it shows both farm numbers.
title: Fuel symbol on the sprayer account

body:
Photograph back at the apple symbol: the rejected fruit crate has clean skins on top and spotted fruit underneath. A field-trial ribbon is tied to one handle.

I did not know where to put it after the shelves were cleared. There was still someone coming back for the answer written on it.

Perhaps the new instructions were meant to help us. They arrived after we had already followed the old ones.
title: Apple symbol and the rejected crate

body:
Repair note at the hammer symbol: replace the pump gasket after the experimental feed runoff. The old rubber had turned green without cracking.

The runoff ran from the trial barn into the same ditch the pump draws from. Two gaskets had gone the same way that season.

I wrote the pump number here for the next man to check.
title: Hammer symbol over a green gasket
